Capacity (MW).note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists Ripley Energy Center, plant 67262, generator RP1, nameplate 419.0 MW, net winter 444.5 MW, planned operation April 2027, under construction more than 50 percent complete. The Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality permit memorandum (https://applications.deq.ok.gov/permitspublic/storedpermits/8877.pdf) describes one combustion turbine with a nominal gross output of 420 MW. qa.question: Should Ripley RP1 capacity change from 445 MW to 419 MW?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) gives 419.0 MW nameplate and 444.5 MW net winter. The state permit memorandum (https://applications.deq.ok.gov/permitspublic/storedpermits/8877.pdf) gives a nominal gross output of 420 MW.
qa.recommendation: Change capacity to 419 MW, the nameplate figure, because the manual wants nameplate and not winter capability.
qa.note: The old Associated Electric Cooperative page could not be read, so I could not see why 445 was used. It likely came from the winter figure.
